label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I ii q.94…: Errors about the secondary precepts of the natural…
locator: I-II q.94 a.6 co.: vel propter malas persuasiones, eo modo quo etiam in speculativis errores contingunt circa conclusiones necessarias
interpretation: As to the secondary precepts the natural law can be blotted out of human hearts, by bad persuasion (as errors happen about necessary conclusions in speculative matters) or by depraved customs and corrupt habits, 'sicut apud quosdam non reputabantur latrocinia peccata'. Read as Aquinas's account of moral error: it is error of the same kind as speculative error, a false judgment. The common principles cannot be blotted out in general.
